sections.content: You know the conditional (*ahorraría*, A2 Unit 26) and *si* + imperfect subjunctive + conditional (*si tuviera…, invertiría…*, B1 Unit 4). Here you use them for money decisions: what you would save, invest or risk.

items.spanish: Ahorraría más si tuviera un salario mayor.
items.english: I would save more if I had a higher salary.

items.spanish: Si tuviera más dinero, invertiría una parte.
items.english: If I had more money, I would invest part of it.
What would you do if you lost your job?
I would not risk all my money.

sections.content: The *si* clause takes the imperfect subjunctive (*tuviera*) and the result takes the conditional (*invertiría*). The two clauses can swap places: *Ahorraría más si tuviera un salario mayor.*
